overall_status: MATCH: (ticket-domain projection: RuleSubCommute::cancelExtensions + the DIV/REM ZEXT-arm partial-commute wiring cc:4551-4562, 9 cases)
status_note: WORKPKG-UNMAP-RULEADJ-0013 B2 fixture for RuleSubCommute::cancelExtensions (ruleaction.cc:4483-4512) driven through BOTH caller arms: the INT_SDIV/INT_SREM SEXT arm (cc:4583-4589, ported by the SUBCOMMUTE lane) and the INT_DIV/INT_REM ZEXT arm (cc:4551-4562, whose partial-commute call was previously 'deferred for simplicity' in Rugra — RULEACTION-SUBCOMMUTE-ZEXT-PARTIAL-0001, closed by this ticket's arm rewrite). Cases: equal-extension cancel (both ext inputs 8 > SUBPIECE output 4: longform rebound to raw a8/b8, fresh 8-byte unique output, SUBPIECE survives reading it), unequal both orders (shortenExtension on the 4-byte side regrows that ZEXT/SEXT output to 8 bytes, cc:4494-4505 loneDescend guard), SEXT-arm mirrors, the three in-helper rejects (longform output second reader cc:4488; equal-arm freed extension input cc:4489-4493; shortened side's extension output second reader cc:4499), plus the full-commute fall-through (both ext inputs 4 <= 4: generic tail creates per-input SUBPIECEs, destroys the original SUBPIECE, longform takes its output).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: cancelExtensions(longform,subOp,ext0In,ext1In,data) mutates Funcdata by reference and REBINDS its ext0In/ext1In value parameters locally when a side is shortened (cc:4498/4504); applyOp returns 1 from inside the switch leaving the SUBPIECE intact, never reaching the cc:4621 loneDescend / cc:4623 RuleSubZext overlap checks on the generic path.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: arm gating order per oracle: in(1) is examined FIRST — cancelExtensions fires only when in(1) is written ZEXT/SEXT and (ext1In > outvn || ext0In > outvn); a written non-extension in(1) rejects before any size question; constant in(1) requires ext0In <= outvn and mask fit; the old Rugra ZEXT arm rejected on ext0In > outvn even for constant in(1), a different route with the same observable but no partial-commute firing.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: maxSize is a per-call local derived once from the ext input sizes; no cross-call state.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: loneDescend pointer-identity guards: longform output's sole descendant must be subOp (cc:4488) and the shortened side's extension output's sole descendant must be longform (cc:4499-4500); isFree gates on both extension inputs in the equal arm; size comparisons: equal inputs take that size, unequal take the larger and shorten the smaller side.

analysis_options: none: direct RuleSubCommute::applyOp harness on a real BfdArchitecture Funcdata; no decompilation pipeline options

rugra_source.note: DIV/REM ZEXT-arm oracle-structure rewrite (cancelExtensions wiring) commit (WORKPKG-UNMAP-RULEADJ-0013); bilateral normal-mode byte equality proven on this tree
